snippet.title: Trepang1 gameplay - the spiritual predecessor to Trepang2
snippet.description:
If you wondered why Trepang2 is called Trepang it's because of this game, a 2d side scroller about sea cucumber (also known as a trepang) who has to go to a randomly located objective in the game and then to the next level and so on. You can shoot your organs at enemies but lose health doing so.
This game crashed at around the 3 minute mark in this video.
This game was in the game jam Ludum Dare 22 (December 2011).

What does Trepang 1 have in relation to Trepang 2? Aside from the same devs I have no idea.


You can find this game in the FAQ section from the official Trepang2 discord.
